subject: Kickoff: cross-dataset label harmonization (missing_link)
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kicking off label harmonization for the vision corpora (window Mar 9 – Jul 6). The asset is our open-source ECCV release: manually verified label relations across three dataset pairs — ade_coco_mapping.csv, ade_bdd_mapping.csv, bdd_coco_mapping.csv — built automatically over MSEG annotations and then hand-corrected. Each row is a simple (label_a, relation, label_b) triple.

Why this matters as a product: Corpus hosts segmentation sets with incompatible label vocabularies, and every team re-derives their own crosswalk. A blessed relation service means joint training and joint eval come for free.

Milestones: April — relation files ingested into Corpus with a query API stub; late May — harmonized ADE20k+COCO training run validating the mappings; late June — full joint-training validation sweep across all three pairs; sign-off by Jul 6.

Staffing and compute asks to me by end of March, please.

Dmitri
